initiatives.name: Oilwatch
initiatives.description: Network of groups resisting oil and gas extraction, with regional networks in Latin America, Africa, South Asia and the Global North. Runs campaigns, advocacy and a small grants program.

initiatives.name:
Center for Interdisciplinary Environmental Justice
                            (CIEJ)
initiatives.description: Collective of activists, academics, scientists and artists working on decolonial environmental justice, including opposition to lithium mining with Indigenous communities in Chile, Argentina and the US Southwest.
